title: FloraFare food_synergies file
description: A file in data/<namespace>/food_synergies/. Either an object with an 'entries' array, a single synergy object, or a bare array of synergies. Files load in data pack order, then by file id; a synergy id defined twice keeps the later definition.

_comment.description: Ignored by the loader — a note for whoever edits the file. Florafare's own tag_categories.json uses it.

id.description: Unique synergy name, shown in the journal and the logs.

requirements.description: Item ids and/or #tags. The synergy runs while the player's ACTIVE BUFFS cover every requirement at once — so keep this at or below maxBuffSlots (3 by default) or it can never trigger.

duration.description: Ceiling in ticks. The synergy runs for the shortest remaining duration among the buffs feeding it, capped here. 0 or less means no ceiling.

health_bonus.description: Extra max health while the synergy is active; negative allowed.

effects.description: Same format as food_buffs. Effect durations are stretched to the synergy's duration.

aftermath.description: What the synergy leaves behind once it ends — same format and rules as a food_buffs entry's aftermath. Starts when the synergy runs out or loses a requirement.

_comment.description: Ignored by the loader — a note for whoever edits the file. Florafare's own tag_categories.json uses it.
